audit_session.mission: Security, correctness, performance and scalability audit
scope_limits: No live staging, production, Atlas, OAuth or email provider was available.
No DAST or load testing; performance findings are code-path analysis, not measurements.
apps/backend-prototype and operator scripts were inventoried but not audited.

coverage_note: Counts come from this ledger. Every file with a finding is inspected and has a regression test. Inspection is not proof of correctness.

reason: Exploratory prototype explicitly not deployed (README); out of production scope.
Operator-run Python importer; needs MONGODB_URI and provider keys to exercise.

title: Dashboard summary misclassifies every registration as completed
evidence: Aggregation ran $dateFromString against a Date-typed registration_deadline. With onError null it produced deadlineDate null, so status was always completed and upcomingDeadlines was always empty.
reproduction: apps/api/test/dashboard-summary.test.js failed before the fix (ongoing count undefined instead of 1) and passes after.
fix: Replaced $dateFromString with $convert to date, which accepts the Date field and legacy ISO strings.

title: Hidden hackathons leak through the alternate moderation flag
evidence: A row with only isHidden true was excluded by GET /hackathons but still returned by GET /calendar, could be saved, could get a reminder and was counted by GET /stats.
reproduction: apps/api/test/hidden-hackathon-visibility.test.js had four failures before the fix; all pass after.
fix: Added shared visibleFilter()/isHidden() helpers and used them in every read path.

title: Account deletion orphans teams and retains personal rows
evidence: DELETE /users/me only set deletedAt. A deleted user remained team leader (team unmanageable), pending join requests stayed pending, active reminders could still email the address, and the purge deleted only users and registrations.
reproduction: apps/api/test/account-deletion.test.js asserts leadership transfer, closed-team reopen, leaderless team deletion, request cancellation, reminder deactivation and full erasure after the retention window.
fix: accountErasure helpers suspend side effects on soft delete; purge removes saved items, reminders, notifications, join requests and registrations before deleting the user.

title: Session credentials written to HTTP logs
evidence: A logged request contained req.headers.cookie with accessToken, req.headers.authorization, res set-cookie and the ?token= verification value in the URL.
reproduction: Observed with LOG_LEVEL=info; apps/api/test/log-redaction.test.js asserts the secrets are absent.
fix: Extracted the HTTP logger, added pino redact paths for cookie/authorization/CSRF/query token/state/set-cookie, and stripped query strings from the logged URL.

title: Teammate discovery loaded the entire filtered user set into memory
confidence: FIXED by code-path change; capacity not measured
evidence: With skills or interests supplied, searchTeammates ran User.find(filter).select(...).lean() with no limit and scored every row in JS before slicing the page.
fix: Ranking moved into a MongoDB aggregation pipeline ($setIntersection/$size/score/$sort/$skip/$limit); only one page of documents is materialised and returned.

title: SSE notification streams were unlimited per account/instance
evidence: Each stream held a response, a 25s interval and an EventEmitter listener; setMaxListeners(0) and no per-user connection cap.
fix: Added sseLimiter (3 streams per account, 500 per instance). The controller returns 429 NOTIFICATION_STREAM_LIMIT and releases the slot on close or error.

title: Public builder counter included banned accounts
evidence: Discovery excluded banned users but GET /stats counted any discoverable non-deleted user, including banned ones.
reproduction: apps/api/test/stats-feedback.test.js fixture includes a banned discoverable builder; builders stays 2.
fix: Added banned not true to the builders count.

title: Legacy hackathon status endpoint labelled events by registration deadline only
evidence: Returned Ongoing while now was before registration_deadline, otherwise Completed; a null deadline became epoch and always reported Completed, and a running event past registration was reported Completed.
fix: Status now uses computeStatus over event start/end with the registration deadline as fallback, exposes statusCode, and returns 404 for hidden or unknown hackathons.

title: Legacy tracking endpoints accepted unvalidated hackathon identifiers
evidence: /api/saved-hackathons save, register and notes upserted rows keyed by any string, unlike /api/saved which resolves and rejects unknown or hidden hackathons.
fix: save/register/notes/status resolve the catalogue row (id or slug, visible only) before writing the canonical hackathon_id; notes are typed and capped at 2000 characters.

title: Scraped external URLs were not scheme-validated before storage
evidence: candidateToDocument stored cleanText(candidate.url) verbatim, so javascript:, data: and other schemes could be persisted.
fix: normalize.safeHttpUrl accepts only http(s); ingest stores safe URLs for url/sourceUrl/imageUrl and sourceRecords.

item: Dual JWT secret acceptance (JWT_SECRET and ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET) is intentional until legacy tokens expire; unify after a token-rotation window.
Rate limits, the hackathon list cache and the scraper run lock are per instance; a multi-instance deployment needs a shared store (Redis) and a database-backed scrape lock.
No DAST, fuzzing, load, soak or failover testing was possible without staging infrastructure; F-05 no longer does unbounded work but its capacity is unmeasured.
OAuth and transactional email flows were not exercised (no provider credentials).
Dependency advisories in the pre-existing docs/security/audit-root.json were not re-verified or upgraded.
apps/backend-prototype, the Python importer, CI workflows beyond lint/test, and infrastructure configs remain unaudited.

note: Final state: 10 findings fixed and verified with regression tests. API 148 pass / 0 fail; API and web lint clean; web suite 33 pass; web build succeeds with a chunk-size warning.
